verdict.rationale: CockroachDB documents programmatic cluster creation and management via the `ccloud` CLI and serverless clusters that scale to zero when idle. Cockroach Continuum also offers cluster virtualization that lets developers and agents deploy virtual clusters on a host cluster, which approximates per-agent isolation. Nothing shows this works cheaply at a scale of thousands of databases, so the fleet-scale part of the story is unproven. missing for 10: evidence of creating thousands of isolated databases cheaply, per-database pricing or quotas at fleet scale, a documented fleet-management API (no OpenAPI spec found), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can cheaply create thousands of isolated databases — one per agent, tenant, or preview — and manage the fleet programmatically

citations.quote: The `ccloud` tool is a command-line interface (CLI) tool that allows you to create, manage, and connect to CockroachDB Cloud clusters.
Cockroach Continuum supports cluster virtualization, allowing application developers and agents to deploy virtual clusters on a dedicated host cluster.
Request Unit consumption scales to zero when your cluster has no activity.
